# Script format

There are two script versions. Both are one JSON object; unknown fields are errors everywhere.

- **Version 1, a clip:** one place, up to 6 characters, a camera track and timed beats. Good for short fights (10-60 s).
- **Version 2, a story:** a cast defined once, reusable locations, and an ordered list of scenes (up to 900 s). Fights are one kind of scene.

## The four `at` forms

Every beat (and camera key) has an `at`:
- `3.5`: seconds (from the clip start in v1, from the scene start in v2);
- `{"after": "k1", "delay": 0.2}`: when beat k1 ends, plus delay;
- `{"with": "k1", "delay": 0}`: when beat k1 starts, plus delay;
- `{"on": "k1.hit", "delay": 0}`: when an anchor of k1 happens. Attacks have `start`, `windowOpen`, `hit`, `end`; other moves `start`, `end`; macros list theirs in 06_story_tools.md.

Any beat another beat refers to needs an `id`. Prefer `after` chains to fixed times: a beat for a busy character waits until it is free.

## Version 1 clip

```
{ "version": 1,
  "meta": { "title": str<=80, "format": "landscape"|"portrait", "seed": int, "theme": <theme>,
            "hpBars": bool, "autoCamera": bool (default true), "stageWidth": 1600-8000 (default 3200) },
  "characters": [ { "id", "x": px, "facing": 1|-1, "color": "#rrggbb", "scale": 0.4-4, "hp": 1-1000,
                    "prop": <prop>|null, "style": { "headband"|"scarf"|"cape"|"hat"|"glow": "#rrggbb", "squash": bool } } ],
  "camera": [ { "at", "mode", "targets"|"target", "zoom": 0.3-4|"auto", "padding", "x", "dur" } ],
  "beats": [ { "id", "at", "who": <id>|"world", "do": <move or world command>, "target", "outcome", "params",
               "speed": 0.25-3, "approach": "run", "interrupt": bool, "fx": [<beat fx>], "say": str<=40, "sayDur": s } ] }
```

- Fights are choreographed: an attack with a `target` always gets its `outcome` (`hit`, `whiff`, `blocked`, `parried`, `dodged`). The defender reacts by itself; never write its block or flinch.
- Give every attack with a target `"approach": "run"`. Damage under 8 flinches, 8-15 rocks the target, 16+ launches it (it then needs `get_up`).
- Damage alone never knocks anyone out: end a fight with `ko_fall` or `ko_spin` on the loser after the finisher.
- Start fighters 300-700 px apart near the middle, facing each other. The first camera key is at 0.

Minimal clip:

```json
{"version": 1, "meta": {"title": "Quick Spar", "format": "landscape", "seed": 7, "theme": "dojo_dusk"},
 "characters": [{"id": "kai", "x": 1300, "facing": 1, "color": "#3fd8ff"}, {"id": "rook", "x": 1800, "facing": -1, "color": "#d23c3c"}],
 "camera": [{"at": 0, "mode": "follow", "targets": ["kai", "rook"], "zoom": "auto", "padding": 300}],
 "beats": [
  {"id": "b1", "at": 0.5, "who": "rook", "do": "taunt"},
  {"id": "b2", "at": {"after": "b1"}, "who": "kai", "do": "cross", "target": "rook", "outcome": "blocked", "approach": "run"},
  {"id": "b3", "at": {"after": "b2", "delay": 0.2}, "who": "kai", "do": "roundhouse", "target": "rook", "outcome": "hit", "approach": "run"},
  {"id": "b4", "at": {"on": "b3.hit"}, "who": "world", "do": "slowmo", "params": {"scale": 0.3, "duration": 0.4}},
  {"id": "b5", "at": {"after": "b3", "delay": 0.6}, "who": "rook", "do": "ko_fall"},
  {"id": "b6", "at": {"after": "b5"}, "who": "kai", "do": "victory"},
  {"id": "b7", "at": {"after": "b6"}, "who": "world", "do": "fade", "params": {"to": "black", "dur": 1}}]}
```

## Version 2 story

```
{ "version": 2,
  "meta": { "title", "format", "seed", "kind": "story"|"fight"|"clip", "audience": "kids"|"general",
            "style": "default"|"soft"|"ink", "autoCamera": true|false|"story" },
  "cast": [ { "id", "name": str<=16, "body": <body plan>, "color", "scale", "hp", "prop": <holdable>,
              "style": {...}, "appearance": {...}, "voice": { "pitch": 0.5-2, "speed": 0.7-1.4, "timbre" } } ],
  "locations": [ { "id", "theme", "stageWidth", "ambience", "time", "weather", "set": [ { "id", "object", "x", "state", "layer" } ],
                   "extras": [ { "count", "behavior", "layer" } ] } ],
  "scenes": [ { "id", "location": <location id or theme>, "time", "weather", "music": { "mood", "intensity" },
                "transitionIn": {...}, "transitionOut": {...},
                "cast": [ { "id", "x", "facing", "face", "hidden": true } ],
                "camera": [...] (optional), "beats": [ <action beats and macro beats> ] } ] }
```

- Action beats keep the v1 shape and add `face`, `partner` (paired moves), `object` (set piece or spawned object id), `to` (`{"x"}`, `{"near", "gap"}` or `{"exit": "left"|"right"}`), `bubble` (`speech`, `think`, `shout`, `whisper`) and `layer`.
- A macro beat is `{ "id", "at", "macro": <name>, "params": {...} }` with no `who` or `do`. A scene macro (`fight_card`, `montage`) is a scene entry `{ "id", "macro", "params" }`.
- Scene times are local (at most 300 s a scene); references stay inside the scene; beat ids are unique across the story (start them with the scene id).
- Characters a scene does not list are absent. `"hidden": true` places someone who arrives later (`@enter`, `spawn`, `return`). hp, defeat, held props and appearance carry over between scenes; positions do not.

Minimal story:

```json
{"version": 2, "meta": {"title": "Park Day", "format": "landscape", "seed": 3, "kind": "clip"},
 "cast": [{"id": "kai", "name": "Kai", "color": "#3fd8ff"}, {"id": "pip", "name": "Pip", "body": "buddy", "color": "#ffcc00"}],
 "locations": [{"id": "park", "theme": "city_park"}],
 "scenes": [{"id": "s1", "location": "park", "music": {"mood": "happy"},
  "transitionIn": {"type": "card", "kind": "title", "title": "Park Day"},
  "cast": [{"id": "kai", "x": 1300, "facing": 1}, {"id": "pip", "x": 1650, "facing": -1}],
  "beats": [
   {"id": "s1_talk", "at": 0.5, "macro": "dialogue", "params": {"lines": [["kai", "Want to play catch?", "happy"], ["pip", "Yes!", "laugh"]]}},
   {"id": "s1_play", "at": {"after": "s1_talk"}, "macro": "activity", "params": {"name": "play_catch", "with": ["kai", "pip"], "reps": 4}},
   {"id": "s1_five", "at": {"after": "s1_play"}, "who": "kai", "do": "high_five", "partner": "pip"},
   {"id": "s1_fade", "at": {"after": "s1_five"}, "who": "world", "do": "fade", "params": {"to": "black", "dur": 1}}]}]}
```

## Two-stage story workflow

1. **Outline:** who is in it, where, and the list of scenes. No beats.
2. **Scenes:** one reply per scene, written from the outline entry and the end state of the scenes before it. Each scene is checked inside the story so far.

The outline:

```
{ "title": str<=80, "logline": one sentence,
  "cast": [ { "id", "name": str<=16, "role": <role, 02_characters.md>, "body", "color", "appearance", "voice", "style", "prop", "hp" } ],   // 2-16
  "locations": [ { "id", "theme", "stageWidth": 1600-12000, "ambience", "time", "weather", "set": [ { "id", "object", "x" } ], "extras": [...] } ],
  "scenes": [ { "id", "purpose": "setup"|"incident"|"journey"|"fight"|"climax"|"resolution"|"breather"|"intro"|"round"|"finale"|"montage",
                "location": <location id>, "time", "weather", "mood": <music mood>, "seconds": 5-300, "cast": [ids, at most 8],
                "summary": "two or three sentences", "events": ["one line per key moment"], "narration": ["card or narration text"] } ] }
```

- The scenes' seconds add up to at least the minimum (story 300 s, fight video 180 s), with about 10% to spare; scenes of 15-40 s (a story has 10-16, a fight video 6-10).
- A story has an arc: setup, incident, journey, climax, resolution; at most half the scenes are fights; a title card first, an end card last. A fight video: an intro, 3-5 rounds getting bigger, breathers, a final round with a comeback, a victory.
- Every cast member appears in a scene; colors stand out on the themes they appear on; 3-6 named characters is easy to follow.
